CETEIcean (CETEI.js)

Version: 1.9.5
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/CETEIcean (npm tarball https://registry.npmjs.org/CETEIcean/-/CETEIcean-1.9.5.tgz)
Upstream repo: https://github.com/TEIC/CETEIcean
License: BSD-2-Clause (Copyright 2016, Hugh Cayless and Raffaele Viglianti; see below)
Vendored file: dist/CETEI.js from the npm package, copied unmodified to CETEI.js in this directory.
  This is the pre-built rollup bundle (single file, IIFE-style, sets window.CETEI) --
  it has no import statements, so it can be loaded directly with a <script> tag and
  needs no build step, consistent with docs/adr/0012-reviewer-ui-static-html-vanilla-js.md.
Date vendored: 2026-07-02
